ISR.headline: Channel 12 exit poll: Likud 24, Yashar 22. Neither bloc reaches 61: the opposition bloc has 52, Netanyahu's bloc 50 and Arab-led parties a record 18.
ISR.headlineIs: Útgönguspá Channel 12: Likud 24, Yashar 22. Hvorug blokkin nær 61: blokk stjórnarandstöðunnar fær 52, blokk Netanyahus 50 og flokkar undir forystu araba metfjölda, 18.
ISR.sourceName: Channel 12 exit poll, 22:00 local time, as reported by Ynet and the Times of Israel
ISR.sourceNameIs: Útgönguspá Channel 12 kl. 22 að staðartíma, samkvæmt Ynet og Times of Israel
ISR.note: Otzma Yehudit's 7 seats follow from Channel 12's bloc total of 50. Channel 13: Likud 25, Yashar 23, Together 14; opposition bloc 53, Netanyahu bloc 50, Arab-led parties 17. Below the 3.25% threshold in both: Reservists, Amcha Yisrael and Haredi Public. Exit polls are projections; the official count follows overnight.
ISR.noteIs: 7 sæti Otzma Yehudit leiða af heildartölu Channel 12 fyrir blokk Netanyahus (50). Channel 13: Likud 25, Yashar 23, Beyachad 14; blokk stjórnarandstöðunnar 53, blokk Netanyahus 50, flokkar undir forystu araba 17. Undir 3,25% þröskuldi í báðum: HaMiluimnikim, Amcha Yisrael og Haredi Public. Útgönguspár eru áætlanir; opinber talning fylgir í nótt.
